title: Select [DISTINCT]
description:
## SELECT DISTINCT
Sometimes your query returns duplicate rows. `DISTINCT` removes them.
```sql
-- Without DISTINCT: shows duplicates
SELECT status FROM invoices;
-- unpaid
-- paid
-- pending
-- unpaid    <- duplicate!

-- With DISTINCT: unique values only
SELECT DISTINCT status FROM invoices;
-- unpaid
-- paid
-- pending
```
